name: Default
shortDescription: Network video recorder with real-time object detection for IP cameras, running OpenVINO on the CPU with recordings kept on a persistent volume.

alerts.message: The admin password is generated on first start and printed in the container logs. Sign in as admin with it and change it under Settings > Users.

Cameras must be reachable from this server over RTSP or HTTP, so cameras on a home network need a VPN or port forward. Only the web UI is published: WebRTC (8555) and the RTSP restream (8554) are not, so live view falls back to MSE or jsmpeg over the web port and two-way talk is unavailable.
